results.evidence: The 1,280 ft ascent / 592 ft descent / 2.8 mi figures are the one-way leg from the Klawatti area to Austera (SummitPost states exactly this leg; Mountain Project lists the route length as 1280 ft), not a car-to-car total. The row's own itinerary days (5400+1800+0 gain, 0+1800+5400 loss), totalNote (~7,000+ ft), approach (5,500-6,000 ft to high camp) and waypoints (2,100 ft trailhead to 8,339 ft summit) all agree on ~7,200 ft; the external leg figure (1,280 up + 592 down each way = ~1,870 ft per direction) plus a ~5,400 ft trailhead-to-camp climb reproduces the itinerary's 7,200 ft. A winter party doing Klawatti+Austera+Eldorado logged 16 mi / 9,000 ft, consistent once the two extra summits are removed.
